slant4d.note: Slant4D operator MCP server. Uses Cloudflare Access OAuth on first connection and exposes catalog, corpus, inventory, and lifecycle proof tools when authenticated.

slant4d-codemode.note: Slant4D Cloudflare Code Mode portal. Use portal_codemode_search and portal_codemode_execute; mcp-remote is required because Codex native HTTP OAuth treats the query-string URL as the OAuth resource.
